Q6097.reason: In most states a grant to someone and the heirs of his body creates a fee simple absolute, so the later deed to the niece conveys nothing.

Q8324.reason: Extreme agitation and aggression fit an overactive dopamine state, and seizure-like activity is the only option that describes hyperactivity rather than dopamine loss.
